additional_context: AuditEvent and Provenance are active resources in source/fhir.ini. The remaining inconsistency was in active Provenance fhirauditevent mappings, where Provenance.target and Provenance.entity.what still pointed to the retired AuditEvent.entity.reference path. FHIR-17413 belongs to the same historical commit family and is already represented on the combined branch; FHIR-15659 is the related broader Provenance cleanup; FHIR-32449 later made AuditEvent.agent.who 1..1 and does not conflict.
reconciliation: Changed source/provenance/structuredefinition-Provenance.xml so both fhirauditevent mappings now target AuditEvent.entity.what instead of AuditEvent.entity.reference.
